newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault hires senior Michelin exec.
newsitem.headline: Renault hires senior Michelin exec.

text.p: Carmaker Renault SA said it had hired Carlos Ghosn, head of tyremaker Michelin's North American activities, to head its research, purchasing, vehicle and mechanical engineering and manufacturing departments.
Ghosn, 42, will join Renault on October 15 and will be appointed executive vice president on December 1 and a member of the group executive committee, Renault said in a statement.

He will take over many of the activities currently headed by Renault executive vice president Philippe Gras, who will keep some of his responsibilities and will also become the boss of the chief financial officer and corporate controller.
The management appointments show Renault Chairman Louis Schweitzer's "determination to open up and internationalise the Renault Group," the company statement said.
In addition to heading Michelin North America, Ghosn was put in charge in February of the Michelin Group's worldwide passenger and light truck tyre business.
